propositions: A test-fixture bare repository created with `git init --bare` at git defaults runs `git maintenance run --auto --quiet --detach` as a background process after receive-pack, leaving a concurrent mutator running after push returns

shutil.copytree immediately following a push into such a fixture races the detached maintenance process, which prunes loose-object fanout directories mid-walk, causing unpredictable ENOENT failures on arbitrary objects/ subdirectories, not just maintenance.lock

The fix pins `receive.autogc=false`, `gc.autoDetach=false`, and `maintenance.autoDetach=false` on the fixture bare remote before any push, structurally eliminating the concurrent mutator rather than narrowing the race window

A new guard test `test_fixture_bare_remote_leaves_no_detached_upkeep_behind_a_push` runs the push under GIT_TRACE2_EVENT and asserts no `git maintenance run` child carries `--detach`, with a positive control ensuring the trace recorded receive-pack to prevent vacuous pass
The fix removes the race without retry loops, sleeps, timing bounds, or `*.lock` ignore predicates, making the test's correctness a structural property of the fixture rather than a probability
